cases.name: peak-at-is-not-a-number
cases.description: peak_at is a row index, so a season name is not one
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="timeseries" base="15" amplitude="10" period="12" peak_at="summer"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: peak-at-with-no-period
cases.description: a wave needs a length before it can have a highest point
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="timeseries" base="15" amplitude="10" peak_at="6"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>
